data.title: Payment reminder from MusterFit Studios – returned direct debit
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH sent a reminder because the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee was returned by the bank. €47.40 (€39.90 fee plus €7.50 reminder fee) is due by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your gym could not collect the November 2025 membership fee because your bank returned the direct debit. The gym now asks you to pay the open €39.90 plus a €7.50 reminder fee (Mahngebühr), €47.40 in total, by 12 December 2025. Transfer the money to the account shown in the letter. If you already paid, you can treat the letter as settled. Check that your bank account has enough funds so future debits work. If you think the fee is wrong, contact the studio.
